meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相唱反调,把方案在定稿前反复挑刺打磨。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在重要决策前想先让立场不同的 AI 相互找茬。
copy.tagline_en: Pit multiple AI agents against each other to stress-test a plan before it is finalized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want opposing AI voices to challenge a critical plan before committing.

howto.what: Claude 会先组建一支 5 人对抗团队,成员彼此挑刺、攻击对方结论,只保留扛住攻击的观点,再交给专门的规划者写成正式执行方案。
howto.when: 当你要求 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式规划,或规划需要最高严谨度时触发;需团队工具可用且你在主会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我把这个方案过一遍对抗批判。
say.note: 先出现 HYPERPLAN MODE 提示,再组队批判

say.text: 启动 hyperplan,对这份迁移计划做对抗式交叉批判。
say.note: 5 名成员互相攻击后交由规划者成文

say.text: 对这份需求文档跑一次 hyperplan,只保留经得起攻击的结论。
say.note: 弱结论会被淘汰,留下的才进方案

howto.what_en: Claude forms a 5-member adversarial team whose members attack each other's findings, keeps only the insights that survive the attacks, then hands them to a dedicated planner that writes the formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a hyperplan, an adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor. Requires the lead team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Run hyperplan on this proposal for an adversarial critique.
say_en.note: Starts HYPERPLAN MODE and spawns the team

say_en.text: Start hyperplan and cross-critique this migration plan.
say_en.note: 5 members attack, then a planner formalizes

say_en.text: Run hyperplan on this requirements doc; keep only defensible conclusions.
